notes.title: Wishlist Now! Launching Our New Detective Game Based on a True Crime Story
notes.content:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the underworld of [b]1980s Amsterdam [/b]with our thrilling new detective game, inspired by a [b]real crime story[/b]. Step into the shoes of a sharp investigator and navigate the shadows of the city's notorious[b] red light district[/b]. Uncover hidden secrets, crack cryptic puzzles, and chase down elusive clues—all from the comfort of your home. 🕵️‍♂️

[h3]🎮 Launch Date: [b]September 23, 2024[/b][/h3]

📽️ Watch the Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=wTLhTYpcPis;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]✨ Top Features:[/h3]
Examine intricate crime scenes with interactive elements and hidden details.
Immerse yourself in an authentic 1980s Amsterdam setting with true-to-life locations and events.
Solve complex detective cases with interactive, puzzle-based gameplay.

[b]👉 Wishlist the game now on Steam to be one of the first to play on launch day![/b]
🗣️ Join our community on Discord for exclusive updates and sneak peeks.
📲 Follow us on social media to stay connected: https://www.instagram.com/mysterycitygames/


🔗 Store Page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866640/A_Death_in_the_Red_Light/


Don’t miss out on the chance to unravel the truth—your next adventure awaits!
